avoidWhen: the project or task explicitly requests an unframed design surface
useWhen: the active profile should make a prototype recognizable as XFT

records.summary: Recognizable XFT prototype framing around a page without owning routing, permissions, or page decisions.

limitations: Prototype framing only; routing, permissions, and side-navigation state remain page-owned.
Side navigation contains stable module-level destinations in the workspace, such as Module page A / Module page B.
Page-local views, modes, filters, and content switching belong in children within the Primary Work Surface; the frame does not express product-level primary navigation.
workspaceTop and workspaceBottomDock are generic ReactNode positions; their content and business semantics remain page-owned.
The frame does not provide a permanent white page wrapper or choose a work-surface mode.

records.title: XFT Application Frame

avoidWhen: the page has at least two main layout columns and multiple independent content regions
useWhen: a standard form, query, single-list, configuration, or other page has one primary work area

records.summary: Page-owned primary bright surface for a standard XFT work page on the muted workspace canvas.

limitations: The page supplies all titles, navigation, forms, tables, actions, data, and handlers.
The template does not own workspace chrome, a bottom dock, or multi-region layout.

records.title: XFT Primary Work Surface

avoidWhen: later inputs depend on validated earlier stages or work must resume by stage
useWhen: one continuous business form can be completed without stage ownership changes

records.summary: Continuous grouped form with section navigation for work that does not have real stage boundaries.

limitations: Page supplies Form fields, validation, data, and handlers.
Draft persistence and error-summary content are page-provided prototype boundaries.

records.title: Single-page Business Form

avoidWhen: steps would only split a continuous form for visual convenience
useWhen: the business process has real stage boundaries

records.summary: Explicit stages for forms with validation dependencies, handoffs, recovery, or consequential completion.

limitations: Page owns stage state, per-stage validation, draft persistence, and business side effects.

records.title: Staged Business Form

avoidWhen: the task explicitly targets a product other than 企业财富+
the task explicitly requests an unframed design surface
useWhen: the active 财富+ token preset should produce a recognizable 企业财富+ desktop operations page

records.summary: 企业财富+桌面应用框架：顶部一级菜单、无侧栏、18px 页面标题、40px 表头、50px 内容行、纵向表单、300–480px 录入控件及小圆角按钮。

limitations: Top navigation contains the page's first-level menu; do not add a left or right side navigation.
Render the page-level title at exactly 18px; omit it when tabs, breadcrumbs, or an object hero already provides the page identity.
For query and filter controls, do not render a preceding field name or Form.Item label. Put the criterion name inside the Input or Select placeholder, for example placeholder="管理机构".
Keep every table header row at exactly 40px high.
Keep every table body row at exactly 50px high.
Use a vertical label-above-control structure for every data-entry form; never place form labels and controls side by side. Query and filter controls remain label-free as specified separately.
Keep Input, InputNumber, date input, and Select controls between 300px and 480px wide; use 300px as the minimum and 480px as the maximum.
Do not use a border radius smaller than 2px on rounded UI elements; use the staged small-radius token rather than a new literal value.
Use the small-radius token for every button, including primary navigation, primary, default, text, icon, and danger buttons.
The page supplies navigation labels, active state, global actions, filters, tables, content, data, and handlers.
The template is a desktop prototype frame; routing, permissions, and responsive mobile navigation remain page-owned or out of scope.

records.title: 企业财富+ Application Frame
